_comment: CC0 RAW samples from https://raw.pixls.us (licence checked per file). Fetched by scripts/fetch_samples.py. Each entry: {name, url, sha256, camera, notes}.

samples.name: dji-fc4382.dng
samples.notes: DJI DNG with BaselineExposure +1.32 EV (closest relative of the Pocket 4 DNGs); bright sky over dark forest (R03-like).

samples.name: pentax-k5iis.dng
samples.notes: DNG with BaselineExposure ≈ +0.49 EV; indoor tungsten light at night (R06-like).

samples.name: pentax-q7.dng
samples.notes: Small-sensor DNG, black level 0 (like the Pocket 4); dark low-key interior, ISO 800 (R05-like low key).

samples.name: sony-ilme-fx3.arw
samples.notes: Non-DNG Bayer RAW, black level 512; warm indoor light at ISO 20000 (R10-like noise).

samples.name: fujifilm-xq1.raf
samples.notes: X-Trans (6×6 CFA); daylight at −1 EV exposure compensation (R02-like).

samples.name: fujifilm-x-s10.raf
samples.notes: X-Trans (6×6 CFA); colour chart under indoor light, for colour accuracy checks.
